source_label_caveat: Externally posted labels/plans may themselves be agent-assisted; author login is not proof of unaided human judgment. No explicit source design/review class labels found. Implementation labels are inherited, not independently adjudicated.
stage_rubric: Design none when latest plan explicitly settles approach; opus when plans leave interacting semantic/representation choices. Review sonnet for bounded oracle-pinned edits, opus for acceptance widening, shared semantic invariants or rollback. Ambiguous stages unscored. No Fable coercion.
